3:Read after a failed step, or for profile repair and static-to-Worker migration. Start with the returned error and logs when available; fix the identified cause and rerun the affected step. Reuse successful results whose inputs remain unchanged. For source or publishing failures, keep the same Site identity and follow the [workflow](../SKILL.md#workflow).
15:Repair identified source or configuration defects before publishing; retain proven compatibility repairs. Retry preview only after a concrete repair or evidence of infrastructure recovery. Missing CLI, daemon, browser routing, or static-preview dependencies are environment limitations. For managed previews, do not replace infrastructure, change network permissions, bypass the sandbox, or modify working application code to compensate. Report browser QA as unverified and continue appropriate checks and publishing unless passing browser QA is required.
19:If deployment reports success without a URL, make one status call for that deployment; report incomplete verification if the URL is still missing.
